pages.text: Right-click a Town Hall that belongs to no town yet and give it a name: the colony exists, and only then can other buildings go up. A player can only have one town.$(br2)The panel is also where you rename the town. The naming style for future tourists and mages, and whether tourists keep arriving, live in the $(l:wandscape:management/panel_settings_guide)Settings Center$(/l) under the "My Town" tab— those only change your own town. See $(l:wandscape:system/town_level_guide)Town Level$(/l) for leveling.
